{
  "name": "cm-context-meter",
  "displayName": "Context Meter",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Puts context-window fill, 5-hour/7-day plan usage and session cost in the status line, and warns once when the context gets full.",
  "author": {
    "name": "ClaudeMods",
    "url": "https://claudemods.app"
  },
  "homepage": "https://claudemods.app/mods/cm-context-meter",
  "repository": "https://github.com/rotbit/claudemods-marketplace",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "status line",
    "context window",
    "usage",
    "rate limits",
    "cost"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "showCost": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show cost",
      "description": "Show the session's cost in US dollars, as /cost totals it.",
      "default": true
    },
    "showRateLimits": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show plan usage",
      "description": "Show the 5-hour and 7-day plan usage windows (subscriptions only).",
      "default": true
    },
    "warnAtPercent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Warn at context %",
      "description": "Show a toast once when the context window reaches this percentage; 0 turns the warning off.",
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "default": 80
    },
    "format": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Format",
      "description": "compact: ctx 42% · 5h 23% · $1.20. verbose: Context 42% (84k/200k) · 5-hour 23% · Cost $1.20.",
      "options": [
        "compact",
        "verbose"
      ],
      "default": "compact"
    },
    "intervalMs": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Refresh interval (ms)",
      "description": "How often to refresh between turns, in milliseconds (at least 5000).",
      "min": 5000,
      "max": 3600000,
      "default": 60000
    }
  }
}
